name: Bach Ma food guide
summary: The meal before the climb is at chợ Cầu Hai: brick crab with a thin shell and sweet red roe, land shrimp, and brackish fish from the lagoon, then a thick coffee brewed the Huế way. Bánh ép Cầu Hai is the pressed cake, and inside the park breakfast is a short list.
body: Eat at the market on National Highway 1A, then go up the mountain. Huế bowls stay in Huế. Lăng Cô’s beach dishes stay on that bay. In thị trấn Cầu Hai the morning starts with a thick coffee, brewed the Huế way, then a walk across the road into the market facing the lagoon.

The crab has a thin shell and red roe, and both the meat and the roe are sweet. The land shrimp is what Huế cooks as tôm chua, with boiled pork and pickled bean sprouts. The fish are cá kình, cá dìa, cá hanh, and cá đối, caught in phá Tam Giang and đầm Cầu Hai. People buy the seafood to cook, often for the weekend. It comes in still brackish, with the salt of the sea mouths.
The kitchens inside the park, allowed by the management, serve phở, bún, or mì bò at breakfast, and cơm đĩa or cơm phần. Grill or seafood can be ordered ahead.
specialtiesLead: Brick crab, land shrimp, four lagoon fish, a thick Huế-style coffee, and bánh ép Cầu Hai. Tôm chua is the Huế plate made from this shrimp. The park breakfast is phở, bún, mì bò, and set rice.

sections.heading: Cau Hai specialties
paragraphs: Buy the crab, the land shrimp, and the fish at chợ Cầu Hai, or drink the coffee in thị trấn Cầu Hai before you cross the road. Bánh ép Cầu Hai is the pressed cake from the same lagoon.

sections.heading: The Hue plate
paragraphs: Tôm chua is a Huế dish. The land shrimp at chợ Cầu Hai is the ingredient, and Huế restaurants serve the plate with boiled pork and pickled bean sprouts.

sections.heading: Cau Hai market
paragraphs: Chợ Cầu Hai is the buy, on National Highway 1A, about 40 km south of Huế, facing the lagoon. The rows are fish, crab, and vegetables. The market is the landmark for the left turn onto Trần Đình Túc.
The same morning’s basket, for a sour soup or a hotpot cooked later in Huế or Đà Nẵng, is fig, pickled taro stem, green banana, sour star fruit, herbs, green chili, pennywort, and malabar spinach.

spots.name: Cau Hai market
spots.note: Buy the crab, the land shrimp, and the four fish here, then go to the gate.

sections.heading: Breakfast inside the park
paragraphs: A few kitchens inside the park are allowed by the management. Breakfast is phở, bún, or mì bò. Cơm đĩa and cơm phần are the set rice. Grill or seafood can be ordered ahead. Drinks and snacks are on request.

seoTitle: Bach Ma food guide — crab and fish at Cau Hai
seoDescription: Brick crab with sweet red roe, land shrimp, and four lagoon fish at chợ Cầu Hai, then a short breakfast inside Bach Ma.
